revisions.text: When summoning the patron, you may hear your allies call out, Let's go mid! Fear not, your teammates aren't having a stroke. They're merely trying to direct you towards the Rejuvenator, a powerful relic that can give you mastery over death itself. But in order to claim the Rejuvenator, you must first defeat a powerful entity that protects it. Kill the entity, punch the Rejuvenator, and fear death no more. For more ritual survival tips, get your copy of the New York Oracle today.
